decisions.rationale: Dynamic HTML was unnecessary and unsafe.
decisions.verification: npm run review:security confirms hostile notes are escaped.

decisions.rationale: Authorization and evidence belong at the service boundary.
decisions.verification: npm run review:security exercises direct service calls and actor checks.
decisions.residual_risk: Actor identity is an in-memory exercise fixture.

decisions.rationale: Native controls provide keyboard semantics with less code.
decisions.verification: npm run review:accessibility checks buttons and aria-pressed.
decisions.residual_risk: Manual screen-reader coverage remains outside scope.

decisions.rationale: One reduction produces the intended risk without repeated work.
decisions.verification: npm run review:performance and the protected measurement pass.

decisions.rationale: Memoization avoids recomputation when reviews are unchanged.
decisions.verification: npm run review:performance checks useMemo dependency ownership.
decisions.residual_risk: React profiling outside the protected scenario is not included.

decisions.rationale: Injected waiting removes browser and real-time nondeterminism.
decisions.verification: npm run review:testability passes with a fake wait at the service boundary.
decisions.residual_risk: Network behavior is simulated rather than end-to-end.

decisions.rationale: UI-only authorization leaves direct service callers unrestricted.
decisions.verification: Source and tests prove actor validation is enforced at the service boundary.
decisions.residual_risk: No residual UI-bypass risk remains in the exercise boundary.

interactions.resolution: One service-boundary change accepts an explicit actor and injectable wait while enforcing authorization and evidence before approval.
interactions.residual_risk: The exercise uses an in-memory actor rather than production identity infrastructure.
